a.xlink:title: Splits every approved edge, once per undirected edge.
Is half-edge h a legal and wanted split candidate?
Splits the edge of half-edge h at its midpoint.
Common preconditions: the edge and both endpoints are live and untouched.
Is h the half of its undirected edge the operators are offered?
Squared length of half-edge h. Prefer this wherever the sqrt can be avoided.
The triangle half-edge h belongs to.
The seam-consistent vector along half-edge h, origin -> target.
The shortest vector from p1 to p2 under the minimum-image convention.
Read-only position of vertex v: three contiguous doubles.
Makes x and y twins. Both must be live half-edges.
Re-points a rim half-edge at outer, which may be MFTL_ERROR.
Next half-edge in the triangle's CCW cycle.
Previous half-edge in the triangle's CCW cycle (== next twice).
Declares every derived array stale. Call after editing topology by hand.
Midpoint of pa and pb, minimum-image correct and wrapped.
Appends a triangle AND its three half-edges.
Appends a vertex at pos with a fresh global id.
Writes triangle t as the CCW vertex triple (v0, v1, v2).
Wraps a position into the periodic domain box by at most one period.
Grows both pools by at least the given amounts, geometrically (MFTLGrowCapacity()),...
Sets the active and owned counts of both pools.
Geometric growth policy: at least needed, at least MFTL_INIT_CAPACITY, otherwise double until it fits...
Grows the triangle pool to capacity triangles; never shrinks.
Grows the vertex pool to capacity vertices; a no-op if it already holds that many (the ratchet MFTLOb...
Resizes the triangle pool (and its half-edges) to exactly capacity triangles, up or down....
Allocates bytes, 64-byte aligned, aborting on failure.
Lays out a triangle block for cap triangles and 3 cap half-edges: rec, he, area, normal,...
Points every field of p into blk according to l.
Rounds x up to the next multiple of a.
Reserves one sub-array inside a pool block and returns its byte offset.
Resizes the vertex pool to exactly capacity vertices, up or down.
Lays out a vertex block for cap vertices: rec, pos, normal.
Points every field of p into blk according to l.
Grows both pools to hold at least the given counts, exactly.
